title: Microsoft Purview DLP: set policy tips and email notifications separately for SharePoint and OneDrive rules (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: Hold: the impact rationale promises that users see changes only after an administrator edits a rule, although the effect on existing rules is not stated. The claim that Learn does not describe separate notification options also overlooks the documented PowerShell parameter and its email-only and policy-tip-only values.

claims.claim: The printed Microsoft Purview portal creation path reaches the User Notifications section of a SharePoint and OneDrive DLP rule.
claims.quote: Select Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy. ... Select Custom from both the Categories list and the Regulations list. ... On the Customize advanced DLP rules page, select + Create rule. ... Set the User Notifications toggle to On.
claims.fix: Expand the path to 'Data loss prevention > Policies > + Create policy > Enterprise applications & devices > Categories: Custom > Regulations: Custom > Assign admin units > Choose where to apply the policy > Define policy settings > Create or customize advanced DLP rules > Customize advanced DLP rules > + Create rule > User Notifications'. The cited walkthrough already has the advanced-rules option selected; omitted scope and wizard headings do not invalidate the existing route. Qualify the note with 'This walkthrough shows the combined policy-tip option, not the four separate portal choices.'
